title: Language and Postcards
author: Sebastian Whitlock
blurb: Ansel Eriksen, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
